meaning:
Abarim = "regions beyond"
a mountain or range of mountains on the east of the Jordan, in the land of Moab, opposite to Jericho; Mount Nebo is part of this range
Another name of ne.vo (נְבוֹ "(Mount )Nebo" H5015H)

elsewhere.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
“Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the…
“Go up to Lebanon, and cry. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.
